Coverage account: The target population is all current Garden Club North members during May. The frame is a portal snapshot exported on 31 May and includes only members with an email account in the club portal; paper-only members are excluded. Coverage is therefore limited to portal-represented members and may omit current members who do not use the portal.

Time bound: Findings apply to the 31 May snapshot and the May target period. Duplicate mechanism: one member may have both personal and work portal accounts, creating duplicate records and possible overcounting unless accounts are linked. Unknowns: whether all current members use the portal, and whether duplicate accounts can be reliably identified. Conflicts: the target includes all current members, while the inclusion rule requires a portal email account.

Verification findings: The supplied facts establish the inclusion and exclusion rules and the duplicate risk; they do not establish total coverage or deduplication quality. Outside scope: changing the frame, contacting members, linking accounts, or estimating missing-member counts.
